body_lead: Gujarat High Court bans use of AI by judges, court staff in judicial work The policy prohibits the use of AI tools in the judicial decision-making process and fastens personal liability on concerned judges or court officers for AI-assisted outputs. The Gujarat High Court has released a policy barring the use of artificial intelligence tools by judges and court staff in the State for drafting orders, judgment preparation or any other form of judicial decision-making.
